messages:
Lina (docs): opened a quick PR to patch docs/known-issues after last night's outage. adds status page link + a short 'if-you-see-this' workaround for KV cache eviction. asking for a fast review/merge today.
Avery (oncall): posting the incident link here please so customers get exact context.
Lina (docs): https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-03-18-region-degradation — will add it to the top as the canonical ref.
Diego (docs-reviewer): i'll take a look in ~10m. is the change mostly the link and a 3-step mitigation?
Lina (docs): yep, 3 bullets: 1) flush local prefix cache, 2) reduce batch size to 1 for writes, 3) set eviction retry to manual. short and concrete.
ci-bot: docs-preview queued for PR #4322
Priya (platform): small heads-up: our docs migration removed /legacy paths; avoid relative references to ./legacy/ to prevent preview 404s.
Lina (docs): good call, i used an absolute URL for the status page but one of the internal anchors was pointing to ./legacy. fixing now.
Diego (docs-reviewer): quick nit: please include 'temporary workaround' in the heading so we can remove it automatically after the postmortem.
Lina (docs): added heading "Temporary workaround — KV cache eviction" and updated the wording to be clearly time-limited.
ci-bot: docs-preview completed: build failed (1 broken link) in docs/known-issues.md -> ./legacy/kv.md
Avery (oncall): that broken ref was in the runbook migration, i flagged it earlier. looks like a couple cross-links still reference old docs.
Lina (docs): doing a repo-wide grep for "./legacy/" and replacing with /docs/ equivalents. will push a single fix commit.
Lina (docs): pushed commit to fix anchors and remove legacy refs.
ci-bot: deploy-preview-4322 is live: https://deploy-preview-4322--redwood-docs.netlify.app/docs/known-issues/#temporary-workaround-kv-cache-eviction
Avery (oncall): checked preview — link to status page works, workaround steps are clear. can we add one-sentence caution: "avoid permissive batching until fix is rolled out"? that was key to preventing error spikes.
Lina (docs): added that sentence and reworded step 2 accordingly. tiny commit.
Diego (docs-reviewer): LGTM — approving.
Priya (platform): approved, i'll merge and create a backport to release/stable.
alerts-bot: Incident 2026-03-18: region degradation  link added to docs by Lina
Lina (docs): thanks everyone. filing a task to sync the runbook + postmortem to reference this docs change.
Avery (oncall): huge help, folks. customers asked for these exact steps already so this will cut down support chatter.
Diego (docs-reviewer): note for postmortem: include the deploy-preview URL in the changelog so reviewers can see the rendered text later.
